title: About me
lead: I am a psychologist and psychotherapist trained in Cognitive Behavioural Therapy. I work with adults, couples and adolescents, both in person and through online sessions.
intro:
I graduated from the School of Psychology of the Aristotle University of Thessaloniki and hold a master's degree in Clinical Mental Health from the School of Medicine of the Aristotle University of Thessaloniki. I completed my training in Cognitive Behavioural Therapy at the Hellenic Society for Behavioural Research, and I receive regular clinical supervision.

I have worked at a rehabilitation centre and at a chronic pain clinic. Alongside my private practice, I collaborate with a haemodialysis unit and an oncology clinic, where I provide psychological support both to patients themselves and to their families.

As part of my ongoing professional development, I have attended numerous seminars on topics such as grief management, eating disorders, managing anxiety and depression, the transition to motherhood and aggression in adolescents, among others.
